bio: Hello Harvard community! I am originally from Colorado but spent much of my adult life in Chicago studying at Northwestern and the University of Chicago. Currently, I study Philosophy of Religion and Africana Thought as a PhD student in Religion. I typically like working out and enjoying good conversation over tea or coffee - especially in my areas of interest. I look forward to sharing a space with everyone and hope to contribute in whatever way possible. Community Yards Elm Yard Area Proctors Role Residential Proctors
